problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package A: size 26 units, revenue 166 credits
* Package B: size 33 units, revenue 40 credits
* Package C: size 11 units, revenue 74 credits
* Package D: size 9 units, revenue 256 credits
* Package E: size 46 units, revenue 33 credits
* Package F: size 47 units, revenue 276 credits
* Package G: size 3 units, revenue 294 credits
* Package H: size 45 units, revenue 208 credits
* Package I: size 12 units, revenue 186 credits
* Package J: size 38 units, revenue 52 credits
* Package K: size 6 units, revenue 296 credits
* Package L: size 12 units, revenue 145 credits
* Package M: size 13 units, revenue 143 credits
The drone's cargo bay has a maximum capacity of 210 units. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be loaded in its entirety or not at all.
